::: {.lead}
Minnesota Vikings finished 2025 at 9&ndash;8. The model grades them as a defensive fortress: bottom-quartile offence carried entirely by an elite defence. Historically the least stable archetype year to year.
:::

## What the four phases look like

::: {.sec-note}
EPA **per play** in each of the four phases. Blue is creating points, red is costing them. Defence is sign-flipped so longer blue always means better. All four bars share one league-wide scale (max 0.306 EPA/play), so they are comparable to each other *and* to every other team page. Season totals are deliberately not used here &mdash; mixing totals and per-play rates on one axis would make the offence bars look four times longer than they are.
:::

## Identity

This team classifies as **Defensive Fortress** &mdash; *Bottom-quartile offence carried entirely by an elite defence. Historically the least stable archetype year to year.*

Underneath, the offence reads as **"Marginal — Passing Needs Fixing"**: the label describes how the offence distributes its production between the run and the pass, not how good it is.

| Dimension | Grade |
|---|---|
| Offence tier | **Poor** |
| Defence tier | **Elite** |
| Pass defence rank | **#2** |
| Rush defence rank | **#6** |
| Wins above / below model | **+0.9** |

## Personnel

**Quarterback.** **J.McCarthy** closed the season at **-0.163 EPA per dropback** and **-4.4% CPOE** over his rolling five-game window (through week 18).

**Running back.** **J.Mason** led the backfield with **154 carries** at **-0.041 EPA per rush** (4.6 YPC, 46.1% success). Blocking versus creation: **2.3** yards before contact, **2.4** after. Style: *Contact creator*.

## 2026 outlook

The multi-year prior model projects **8.3 wins** for 2026, with a 90% interval of **1.7 to 14.9**. Fragility flag: **Neutral**.
